primary_endpoint: Access site-related major or minor vascular complications at 30 days.
efficacy_outcome: Primary endpoint: 10% with MANTA vs. 4% with ProGlide (p = 0.16). Modified VCD failure: 20% vs. 40% (p < 0.01), respectively.
safety_signal: Clinically significant access site bleeding was 9% with MANTA vs. 6% with ProGlide (p = 0.57).
